blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا إِيمَانَ لِمَنْ لَا أَمَانَةَ لَهُ، وَلَا صَلَاةَ لِمَنْ لَا طُهُورَ لَهُ، وَلَا دِينَ لِمَنْ لَا صَلَاةَ لَهُ، إِنَّمَا مَوْضِعُ الصَّلَاةِ مِنَ الدِّينِ كَمَوْضِعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط والصغير وقال تفرد به الحسين بن الحكم الحبري الترغيب:٢٤٦/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever does not return to its owner the thing entrusted to him for safekeeping (the amanah) is without complete Iman. Whoever has no Wudu has no Salah. Whoever has no Salah has no Deen. The rank of Salah in the Deen is like the rank of the head in the body” (just as a person cannot live without a head, the Deen will not remain without Salah).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: بَيْنَ الرَّجُلِ وَبَيْنَ الشِّرْكِ وَالْكُفْرِ تَرْكُ الصَّلَاةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب بيان اطلاق اسم الكفر.....، رقم: ٢٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Abandoning Salah takes a person as far as kufr (disbelief in Allah) and shirk (associating partners with Allah).”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The scholars have given several explanations of this hadith. One of them is that the one who does not pray boldly commits sinful deeds, and so there is a danger that he will fall into kufr. Another view stated is that there is a likelihood of an evil death coming to the one who does not pray.
(Mirqat)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ تَرَكَ
